Name: Chubby Berry
Author: Zexu2K
Description:
[b]Description:[/b]
Chubby Berry is a completely fictional fruit, born purely from my imagination! 💭 This unique berry is packed with rich, sweet flavors and brings new delicious recipes to your kitchen. From the smooth and creamy [b]Blue Pudding[/b] to the delightful [b]Chubby Berry Jam[/b], and even a [b]fluffy cheesecake[/b], there's plenty to discover!
📌 [b]What this mod adds:[/b]
[list]
[*]A brand-new [b]fictional fruit[/b]: Chubby Berry 
[*]Several new [b]recipes[/b], including pudding, jam, a jam sandwich, and cheesecake! 
[*]Unique ways to unlock each recipe—befriend Gus and sell ingredients to get them by mail! 📩
How to unlock recipes:[spoiler][code]To unlock the Blue Pudding recipe, befriend Gus!  
📌 Unlock conditions:  
- Reach **at least 1 heart** with Gus ❤️  
- Sell 1 **Chubby Berry**  
Once you meet these requirements, **Gus will send you the recipe by mail**! 📩  
Check your mailbox and enjoy your new dessert! 
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
To unlock the Chubby Berry Jam recipe, befriend Gus!
📌 Unlock conditions:
-Reach **at least 2 hearts** with Gus ❤️
-Cook 1 **Blue Pudding**
Once you meet these requirements, Gus will send you the recipe by mail! 📩
Check your mailbox and enjoy your delicious new jam!
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
To unlock the Toast with Chubby Berry Jam recipe, befriend Gus!
📌 Unlock conditions:
-Reach **at least 3 hearts** with Gus ❤️
-Cook 1 **Blue Pudding** 
Once you meet these requirements, Gus will send you the recipe by mail! 📩
Check your mailbox and enjoy your delicious new breakfast!
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
To unlock the Toast with Cheesecake with Chubby Berry Jam recipe, befriend Gus!
📌 Unlock conditions:
-Reach **at least 5 hearts** with Gus ❤️
- Sell 1 **Chubby Berry** 
Once you meet these requirements, Gus will send you the recipe by mail! 📩
Check your mailbox and enjoy your delicious new cake!
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/code][/spoiler][/list]Time to bring some fantasy flavors to your farm—enjoy!
